learning_objectives.en: Listen for application steps and course details.

passages.title: L-B
passages.text: In England and Wales, compulsory education includes different key stages. As students grow older, the number of subjects and assessment methods changes. At sixteen, students may continue studying in school or college, begin vocational training, or start employment combined with part-time study.
